question: The average age of 28 students of a class is 40 years. If the age of the teacher is also included, the average age of the whole group becomes 41 years. The age (in years) of the teacher is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the Average Net Deviation method:

Age of Teacher = Old Average + (New Total Members × Increase in Average)

Age of Teacher = 40 + (29 × 1)

Age of Teacher = 40 + 29 = 69 years

**∴ The correct answer is 69 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average age of 28 students = 40 years

Average age of 29 persons (28 students + 1 teacher) = 41 years
